name: ECC — Agent Harness Performance Optimization
hook: 288k stars and 42.7k forks. ECC (the tagline: "The agent harness performance optimization system") ships 71 specialized agents, 311 skills, 97 slash-command shims, hooks, and AgentShield — a security scanner for agent configs. Claude Code is the best-supported harness; current release is v2.2.3 (Oct 1). Native Codex and Qoder plugins included; partial adapters cover Cursor, Gemini, Copilot, and more.

name: Hermes Agent — The Agent That Grows With You
hook: 257k stars, 56k forks from Nous Research. Hermes is a multi-provider terminal agent with a built-in learning loop: it creates skills from experience and searches past conversations. Supports 6 terminal backends, a cron scheduler, subagents, and messaging gateways (Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, Signal). Can import settings, memories, and skills from Claude Code, Codex CLI, or Cursor with `hermes import-agent`.

name: UI/UX Pro Max Skill
hook: Now at 140k stars (+1k since yesterday). Claude Code skill that injects professional design decisions — spacing, typography, color systems, component patterns — before any pixel is placed. Surfaces in 2026-10-22 and 2026-10-23 digests; active star growth confirms sustained interest in the design category.

name: Caveman — 65% Token Reduction Skill + Proxy
hook: "Started as a joke in April 2026" — now at 115k stars (+400 since yesterday). A skill + optional proxy for Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor that instructs the agent to strip verbose output to minimal tokens. Community-reported 60–68% cost reduction on typical dev tasks. Still the most-starred pure token-reduction tool in the ecosystem.

name: Agent Skills — Production-Grade Engineering Workflows
hook: 110k stars from Addy Osmani (Google Chrome DevRel lead). 25 skills span the full dev lifecycle: spec → plan → build → verify → review → ship, plus 9 slash commands and 4 agent personas (code-reviewer, security-auditor, test-engineer, web-performance-auditor). Works in Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, and Windsurf. The 7 reference checklists (testing, security, a11y, observability) make it a structured replacement for ad-hoc prompting.

name: Claude Code v2.1.308–310 — Security Hardening + Bedrock/Vertex Monitor
hook: Three releases over Oct 22–23. v2.1.309 is the largest security release in weeks: sandboxed Bash no longer runs shell startup files outside the sandbox before each command, the `--mcp-config` file is protected from sandboxed writes, a redirect-based deny-rule bypass is closed, and Windows PowerShell cd/Set-Location now prompts correctly. v2.1.310 lands the Monitor tool on Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry and adds Enterprise custom-role cloud-session permissions.

name: CC Switch — Multi-Agent Desktop Manager
hook: 148k stars, 9.7k forks. Cross-platform desktop app that manages Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex, and Gemini CLI side-by-side — profile switching, session memory, and usage dashboards in a single window. Updated again Oct 24; community reports it as the de-facto launcher for teams running multiple coding agents.

name: Graphify — Codebase Knowledge Graph
hook: 134k stars. Parses any codebase (plus docs, SQL schemas, configs, and PDFs) into a queryable knowledge graph using local AST parsing — no upload required. Claude Code queries the graph via MCP instead of reading raw files, cutting context window pressure on large repos. Updated Oct 23.

hook: 105k stars. Workspace for running and orchestrating a fleet of coding agents — Claude Code, Codex, and others — across desktop, mobile, and remote environments on your own infrastructure. Supports task queuing, agent handoffs, and live monitoring. Updated Oct 24; Day 3 of trending.
